name: ArmetSK Rounds #20
description:
A box containing twenty metallic rounds. Each round emits a low hum when handled and after prolonged exposure causes a significant psychological dependency, primarily affecting aggression centers and ownership perception.

EFFECT: Rounds create sonic disturbances upon firing, disorienting and incapacitating targets within a ten-meter radius.
ANOMALOUS PROPERTIES: Repeated handling of the rounds induces a psychological compulsion to maintain possession and use, paired with increased aggression and obsessive tendencies in relation to ownership.
TASTE: N/A
PACKAGING: A square, matte cardboard box featuring a stylized hammer and sickle emblem. The text reads 'ArmetSK Rounds'. Indecipherable symbols line the edges.

RESEARCHER NOTE: Probably best not to mix these with other compulsions. Or stress balls.

Dispensed by SCP-261 on 2026-11-15 — edition #20 of the permanent record.
